name: TeleMem
ontology_notes: Mem0-compatible memories keyed by user_id (character/user profile), agent_id, run_id. add_batch writes a private profile per named character plus a shared events scope (user_id=events). Memories are LLM-extracted summaries stored in FAISS plus JSON. No typed relationship state, character autobiography distinct from user facts, lorebook, or OOC. Video memories are a separate captions/VDB pipeline.

ontology.evidence: telemem/mem0.py TeleMemory.add_batch builds user_id_list of each character plus None, which maps to metadata user_id=events via _build_memory_metadata. search tags mem[source] as the scope. Still one memory string type, not companion kinds.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Default infer=True runs get_person_prompt or get_recent_messages_prompt then extract_events_from_text. infer=False stores raw message contents (_add_raw_memories). Custom prompt overrides extraction. Buffer plus _flush_buffer clusters by cosine then LLM fusion (get_update_memory_prompt) and ADD. No joke/hypothetical refusal.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: search() vector-searches the requested user_id and always also searches events, then optional rerank, then truncates to limit (mem0.py search). examples/langchain_memory.py injects hits into the system prompt. Empty results become nothing yet. MCP search_memories returns one fused passage (docs/MCP.md).
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Flush path fuses similar new and old summaries via LLM stored_memories then ADD. Cluster skip if only old memories. Does not show DELETE of the old ids in _flush_buffer. Fusion can merge but old vectors may remain. MCP exposes update_memory and delete_memory.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: run_id scopes a scene. Mem0 metadata typically includes timestamps via the parent class. No validity windows in TeleMemory.search. ZH-4O is long-dialogue QA, not last-Tuesday.
temporal.label: inferred

identity_split.evidence: Per-character user_id plus shared events. examples/multi_npc.py states Mira vs Toma vs events without cross-character leakage. search(user_id=npc) still includes events, so world plot is shared by design. No dedicated relationship object between user and companion.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: search is cosine plus rerank. No silence, trauma, or spoiler API in mem0.py or MCP.md.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Extracted summaries are stored as trusted memory strings and later injected. No provenance or jailbreak filter. infer=False writes raw user/assistant text.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: MCP tools delete_memory and delete_all_memories (docs/MCP.md). TeleMemory inherits mem0.Memory delete/history. No decay or repression. Fusion ADDs rather than guaranteed retract.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Write. one extraction LLM call per (message, user_id) plus embeddings for similar-memory search, plus a fusion LLM call per cluster (add and add_batch). Read. embedding plus FAISS plus optional reranker. README claims lower token cost than Mem0. No published per-turn token budget into the companion prompt.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Apache-2.0. README and site. fully local by default with Qwen or Ollama plus FAISS. pip install telemem. Cloud is optional, not required.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official telemem[mcp] server, eight tools, MCP Python SDK v2, registry uvx telemem (docs/MCP.md). Tools include add, search, get, update, delete, history.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Markets character memory for roleplay and companions and isolates per-character profiles plus a shared events scope. Still a Mem0 drop-in. Retrieve summaries into the prompt. search always mixes in events. No silence, no relationship type, no character-vs-user autobiography split.

published_eval.name: ZH-4O Chinese multi-character long-dialogue QA (also a LongMemEval harness in-repo)
published_eval.claimed_score: 86.33% overall on ZH-4O versus Mem0 70.20%, Memobase 76.78% (Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-Embedding-8B). Reproduction in baselines/.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: QA accuracy on 600-turn multi-character Chinese dialogues. Fact recall and character isolation under that bench. Not social silence, joke-as-fact, persona hijack, or forget-that.
published_eval.source: https://teleai-uagi.github.io/telemem/ and https://github.com/TeleAI-UAGI/telemem README; paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06037

open_unknowns: Whether _flush_buffer ever deletes superseded vector ids, or only ADDs fused summaries.
ZH-4O dataset license and whether the 86.33% number is LLM-as-judge or exact match.
LongMemEval numbers they obtain with the in-repo harness, not published in the README Results table.
